sql-service.name: cs.bis.bis060.total_process_status.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT SUBSTRING(A.REG_DATE,0,9) REG_DATE, ORG2_CD, ORG2_NAME ORG2_NM, (SELECT SUM(Y.DURATION) from (SELECT UCID FROM ms_stt_meta S1 WITH(NOLOCK), vw_usermaster S2 WHERE S1.REG_DATE between ?SDATE and ?EDATE AND SUBSTRING(S1.REG_DATE,0,9) = SUBSTRING(A.REG_DATE,0,9) AND S1.USER_ID=S2.USER_ID AND S2.ORG2_CD = B.ORG2_CD GROUP BY UCID) Z, ms_stt_rslt_merge Y WHERE Z.UCID=Y.UCID) AS DURATION, (SELECT COUNT(1) CALL_CNT FROM (SELECT UCID FROM ms_stt_meta Z WITH(NOLOCK), vw_usermaster Y WHERE Z.REG_DATE between ?SDATE and ?EDATE AND SUBSTRING(Z.REG_DATE,0,9) = SUBSTRING(A.REG_DATE,0,9) AND Z.USER_ID=Y.USER_ID AND Y.ORG2_CD = B.ORG2_CD GROUP BY UCID) R) AS CALL_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(1) CED_CNT FROM (SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO FROM ms_stt_meta Z WITH(NOLOCK), vw_usermaster Y WHERE Z.REG_DATE between ?SDATE and ?EDATE AND SUBSTRING(Z.REG_DATE,0,9) = SUBSTRING(A.REG_DATE,0,9) AND Z.USER_ID=Y.USER_ID AND Y.ORG2_CD = B.ORG2_CD GROUP BY CON_ENT_DGN_NO) R) AS CED_CNT, COUNT(1) TOTAL_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN GRD_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) GRADE_CNT FROM ms_stt_meta a WITH(NOLOCK), vw_usermaster b WHERE a.USER_ID = b.USER_ID AND A.REG_DATE between ?SDATE and ?EDATE ?org1_cd ?org2_flag GROUP BY SUBSTRING(A.REG_DATE,0,9), ORG2_CD,ORG2_NAME ORDER BY SUBSTRING(A.REG_DATE,0,9), ORG2_CD,ORG2_NAME

sql-service.query: SELECT CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO, A.REG_DATE REG_DATE, MAX(ORG2_CD) ORG2_CD, MAX(ORG2_NAME) ORG2_NM, (SELECT SUM(Y.DURATION) from (SELECT UCID FROM ms_stt_meta S1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE S1.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO) Z, ms_stt_rslt_merge Y WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Z.UCID=Y.UCID) AS DURATION, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ms_stt_meta Z WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Z.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO GROUP BY UCID) CALL_CNT, (CASE WHEN MAX(GRD_FLAG) = 'Y' THEN (select CODE_NAME from ms_codebook WITH(NOLOCK) where code_type='VSS160' and code_id = (select ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) from ms_grade_sum Z WITH(NOLOCK) where Z.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO)) WHEN MAX(GRD_FLAG) ='E' THEN (CASE WHEN MAX(TA_FLAG) ='E' THEN '데이터 없음(TA)' WHEN MAX(SRC_FLAG)='E' THEN '오류(검색)' END) ELSE '-' END) GRADE, (CASE WHEN MAX(GRD_FLAG) = 'N' THEN (CASE WHEN MAX(TA_FLAG) = 'Y' AND MAX(SRC_FLAG) = 'Y' THEN '약 7분' WHEN MAX(TA_FLAG) = 'Y' AND MAX(SRC_FLAG) <> 'Y' THEN '약 14분' WHEN MAX(TA_FLAG) <> 'Y' AND MAX(SRC_FLAG)='Y' THEN '약 14분' WHEN MAX(TA_FLAG) <> 'Y' AND MAX(SRC_FLAG) <> 'Y' THEN '약 28분' END) WHEN MAX(GRD_FLAG) = 'E' THEN 'ERROR' ELSE '-' END) REM_TIME from ms_stt_meta A WITH(NOLOCK), vw_usermaster B where A.USER_ID=B.USER_ID and CON_ENT_DGN_NO= ?CED_NO GROUP BY A.REG_DATE,CON_ENT_DGN_NO HAVING A.REG_DATE = MAX(A.REG_DATE)

UNION

sql-service.name: bis.bis040.getOrgStats.org.sel
sql-service.query:
SELECT --BAN_CNT, MEN_CNT 정리(설계번호 개수 대비 몇개)
ISNULL(T.CED_CNT,0) CED_CNT, ISNULL(T.GRADE_SCORE,0) GRADE_SCORE, ISNULL(T.GRADE1_CNT,0) GRADE1_CNT, ISNULL(T.GRADE2_CNT,0) GRADE2_CNT, ISNULL(T.GRADE3_CNT,0) GRADE3_CNT, ISNULL(T.GRADE4_CNT,0) GRADE4_CNT, ISNULL(T.GRADE5_CNT,0) GRADE5_CNT, ISNULL(T.GRADE6_CNT,0) GRADE6_CNT, ISNULL(T.GRADE7_CNT,0) GRADE7_CNT, ISNULL(T.GRADE8_CNT,0) GRADE8_CNT, ISNULL(T.GRADE9_CNT,0) GRADE9_CNT, ISNULL(T.GRADE10_CNT,0) GRADE10_CNT, ISNULL(T.SCRIPT_SCORE,0) VRS_SCORE, CAST((ISNULL(BAN_CNT,0)/CONVERT(float,CED_CNT)) AS NUMERIC(5,2)) AS AVG_BAN_CNT, --소속별 한 설계번호당 말한 평균 필수멘트 건수 -- CAST((ISNULL(MEN_CNT,0)/CONVERT(float,CED_CNT)) AS NUMERIC(5,2)) AS AVG_MEN_CNT, --소속별 한 설계번호당 말한 평균 필수멘트 건수 -- ISNULL(T.FOCUS_SCORE,0) FOC_SCORE, ISNULL(T.SECRET_SCORE,0) SEC_SCORE, ISNULL(BEF.BEF_SCORE,0) BEF_SCORE, ?ORDERBY FROM ( SELECT
COUNT(A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO) CED_CNT, CONVERT(INT,ROUND(AVG(GRADE_SUM),0,0)) GRADE_SCORE, SUM(GRADE1_CNT) GRADE1_CNT, SUM(GRADE2_CNT) GRADE2_CNT, SUM(GRADE3_CNT) GRADE3_CNT, SUM(GRADE4_CNT) GRADE4_CNT, SUM(GRADE5_CNT) GRADE5_CNT, SUM(GRADE6_CNT) GRADE6_CNT, SUM(GRADE7_CNT) GRADE7_CNT, SUM(GRADE8_CNT) GRADE8_CNT, SUM(GRADE9_CNT) GRADE9_CNT, SUM(GRADE10_CNT) GRADE10_CNT, CONVERT(INT,ROUND(AVG(SCRIPT_SCORE),0,0)) SCRIPT_SCORE, SUM(BAN_CNT) BAN_CNT, SUM(MEN_CNT) MEN_CNT, CONVERT(INT,ROUND(AVG(FOCUS_SCORE),0,0)) FOCUS_SCORE, CONVERT(INT,ROUND(AVG(SECRET_SCORE),0,0)) SECRET_SCORE, ?GROUPBY FROM (SELECT -- ms_stt_meta 가입설계번호별로 그룹(ucid정리), -user 정보 매핑. CON_ENT_DGN_NO, MAX(Z.USER_ID) USER_ID, MAX(Y.ORG2_CD) ORG2_CD, MAX(Y.ORG2_NAME) ORG2_NM, MAX(Y.ORG3_CD) ORG3_CD, MAX(Y.ORG3_NAME) ORG3_NM, MAX(Y.USER_NAME)+'('+MAX(Z.USER_ID)+')' USER_NM FROM ms_stt_meta Z, (SELECT ORG1_CD, ORG1_NAME, ORG2_CD, ORG2_NAME,ORG3_CD, ORG3_NAME, USER_ID, USER_NAME FROM vw_usermaster WHERE 1=1 ?new_user_id) Y WHERE Z.USER_ID=Y.USER_ID AND Z.CON_ENT_DGN_DATE between '?SDATE' AND '?EDATE' ?istp_cd ?prod_cd ?ced_no ?user_id ?anl_stat ?org1_cd ?org2_flag ?org3_cd ?grade GROUP BY CON_ENT_DGN_NO) A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT -- 가입설계번호별 Grade정보 B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) GRADE ,GRADE_SUM ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GRADE1_CNT ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GRADE2_CNT ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GRADE3_CNT ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GRADE4_CNT ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) = '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GRADE5_CNT ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GRADE6_CNT ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) = '7' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GRADE7_CNT ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) = '8' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GRADE8_CNT ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) = '9' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GRADE9_CNT ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CHG_GRADE,GRADE) = '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GRADE10_CNT FROM ms_grade_sum B ) AA ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = AA.CED_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT -- 가입설계번호별 준수율 B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,CASE WHEN LEN(B.CTRA_INSA_CLCD) = 1 THEN B.SCORE1 ELSE CASE WHEN B.SCORE1 > B.SCORE2 THEN B.SCORE2 WHEN B.SCORE1<= B.SCORE2 THEN B.SCORE1 END END SCRIPT_SCORE
FROM ms_regu_sum B ) BB ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = BB.CED_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT -- 가입설계번호별 금칙어 B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,ISNULL(COUNT(COUNT),0) BAN_CNT FROM ms_search_sum B WHERE TYPE='1' GROUP BY B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO ) CC ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=CC.CED_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT --가입설계번호별 필수멘트 B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,ISNULL(COUNT(COUNT),0) MEN_CNT FROM ms_search_sum B WHERE TYPE='2' GROUP BY B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO ) DD ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=DD.CED_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT --한 가입설계번호별 집중관리처리율 CED_NO ,ROUND(FOCUS_Y_CNT/CONVERT(float,FOCUS_TOTAL_CNT)*100,2) AS FOCUS_SCORE FROM ( SELECT --한 가입설계번호별 집중관리항목 전체개수, Y개수 B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,COUNT(1) FOCUS_TOTAL_CNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN FOCUS_YN ='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FOCUS_Y_CNT FROM ms_regu_focus B WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO ) AA ) EE ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=EE.CED_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT --한 가입설계번호별 개인정보처리율 CED_NO ,ROUND(SECRET_Y_CNT/CONVERT(float,SECRET_TOTAL_CNT)*100,2) AS SECRET_SCORE FROM ( SELECT --한 가입설계번호별 개인정보처리항목 전체개수, Y개수 B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,COUNT(1) SECRET_TOTAL_CNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN SECRET_YN ='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) SECRET_Y_CNT FROM ms_regu_secret B WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO ) AA ) FF ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=FF.CED_NO
GROUP BY ?GROUPBY ) T LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT -- 조직별 전월평가점수(설계건수가 없는경우 전월평가가 있어도 안나온다.) CONVERT(INT,ROUND(AVG(BEF_SCORE),0,0)) BEF_SCORE, ?GROUPBY FROM ms_bef_est_score A, (SELECT ORG1_CD, ORG1_NAME ORG1_NM, ORG2_CD, ORG2_NAME ORG2_NM,ORG3_CD, ORG3_NAME ORG3_NM, USER_ID, USER_NAME USER_NM FROM vw_usermaster where 1=1 ?new_user_id) Y WHERE A.USER_ID = Y.USER_ID AND MONTH between SUBSTRING('?SDATE',0,7) and SUBSTRING('?EDATE',0,7) ?user_id ?org1_cd ?org2_flag ?org3_cd GROUP BY ?GROUPBY) BEF ON ?JOIN ORDER BY ?ORDERBY

AND Y.ORG2_CD IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS002' AND CODE_ID NOT IN ('KB00','00') AND USE_YN = 'Y')

FROM (SELECT -- BEF_SCORE더함
CED_CNT, GRADE_SCORE, GRADE1_CNT, GRADE2_CNT, GRADE3_CNT, GRADE4_CNT, GRADE5_CNT, GRADE6_CNT, GRADE7_CNT, GRADE8_CNT, GRADE9_CNT, GRADE10_CNT, SCRIPT_SCORE, BAN_CNT, MEN_CNT, FOCUS_SCORE, SECRET_SCORE, BEF_SCORE, T.WORK_MONTH FROM ( SELECT -- WORK_MONTH 1년이상, 1년 미만으로 일단 정리
COUNT(A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO) CED_CNT, ROUND(AVG(GRADE_SUM),2) GRADE_SCORE, SUM(GRADE1_CNT) GRADE1_CNT, SUM(GRADE2_CNT) GRADE2_CNT, SUM(GRADE3_CNT) GRADE3_CNT, SUM(GRADE4_CNT) GRADE4_CNT, SUM(GRADE5_CNT) GRADE5_CNT, SUM(GRADE6_CNT) GRADE6_CNT, SUM(GRADE7_CNT) GRADE7_CNT, SUM(GRADE8_CNT) GRADE8_CNT, SUM(GRADE9_CNT) GRADE9_CNT, SUM(GRADE10_CNT) GRADE10_CNT, ROUND(AVG(SCRIPT_SCORE),2) SCRIPT_SCORE, SUM(BAN_CNT) BAN_CNT, SUM(MEN_CNT) MEN_CNT, ROUND(AVG(FOCUS_SCORE),2) FOCUS_SCORE, ROUND(AVG(SECRET_SCORE),2) SECRET_SCORE, CASE WHEN WORK_MONTH >= 12 THEN WORK_MONTH/12 ELSE WORK_MONTH+'5000' END WORK_MONTH FROM (SELECT -- ms_stt_meta 가입설계번호별로 그룹(ucid정리), -user 정보 매핑. FROM ms_regu_sum B ) BB ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO = BB.CED_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT -- 가입설계번호별 금칙어 B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,ISNULL(COUNT(COUNT),0) BAN_CNT FROM ms_search_sum B WHERE TYPE='1' GROUP BY B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO ) CC ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=CC.CED_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT --가입설계번호별 필수멘트 B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,ISNULL(COUNT(COUNT),0) MEN_CNT FROM ms_search_sum B WHERE TYPE='2' GROUP BY B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO ) DD ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=DD.CED_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT --한 가입설계번호별 집중관리처리율 CED_NO ,ROUND(FOCUS_Y_CNT/CONVERT(float,FOCUS_TOTAL_CNT)*100,2) AS FOCUS_SCORE FROM ( SELECT --한 가입설계번호별 집중관리항목 전체개수, Y개수 B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,COUNT(1) FOCUS_TOTAL_CNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN FOCUS_YN ='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FOCUS_Y_CNT FROM ms_regu_focus B WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO ) AA ) EE ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=EE.CED_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT --한 가입설계번호별 개인정보처리율 CED_NO ,ROUND(SECRET_Y_CNT/CONVERT(float,SECRET_TOTAL_CNT)*100,2) AS SECRET_SCORE FROM ( SELECT --한 가입설계번호별 개인정보처리항목 전체개수, Y개수 B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,COUNT(1) SECRET_TOTAL_CNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN SECRET_YN ='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) SECRET_Y_CNT FROM ms_regu_secret B WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY B.CON_ENT_DGN_NO ) AA ) FF ON A.CON_ENT_DGN_NO=FF.CED_NO GROUP BY WORK_MONTH --년수 대비 쪼갬. ) T LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN WORK_MONTH >= 12 THEN WORK_MONTH/12 ELSE WORK_MONTH+'5000' END WORK_MONTH, ROUND(AVG(BEF_SCORE),2) BEF_SCORE FROM ms_bef_est_score A, ( SELECT DISTINCT WORK_MONTH, Z.USER_ID, SUBSTRING(CON_ENT_DGN_DATE,0,7) CON_ENT_DGN_DATE FROM ms_stt_meta Z, (SELECT ORG1_CD, ORG1_NAME ORG1_NM, ORG2_CD, ORG2_NAME ORG2_NM, ORG3_CD, ORG3_NAME ORG3_NM, USER_ID, USER_NAME USER_NM FROM vw_usermaster where 1=1 ?new_user_id) Y WHERE Z.USER_ID=Y.USER_ID AND Z.CON_ENT_DGN_DATE between '?SDATE' and '?EDATE' ?istp_cd ?prod_cd ?ced_no ?user_id ?anl_stat ?org1_cd ?org2_flag ?org3_cd ?grade ) Z WHERE A.USER_ID=Z.USER_ID AND A.MONTH=Z.CON_ENT_DGN_DATE GROUP BY WORK_MONTH) BEF ) BEF ON T.WORK_MONTH=BEF.WORK_MONTH
